name: AH 5335
title: Community Nutrition Education and Behavioral Intervention Delivery for At-Risk Groups
description: Community nutrition experiences with income-challenged individuals and families aligned with the model of health promotion sciences and towards achieving entry-level competence in community nutrition and public health.
requirement_description: Students must earn a “C” or higher in DIET 3215, 3230, 3231W, 3235, 3250, 3272.
